title: Mouse Without Borders keeps dropping its connection automatically, which stops the mouse cursor from moving seamlessly across the two devices.
summary: The existing discussion already extracts both settings-file contention and a socket abort from the supplied archive. Those are correlations, not proof that duplicate processes or file locking caused the disconnect; pair the same incident with the other computer.

Please give one disconnect timestamp, both computers' PowerToys versions and service-mode settings, and whether either PC locked, slept or changed network then.
